subject: Commercial playbook: minimum commits, pricing slabs, and net-terms handoff
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@novatech.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novatech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft commercial appendix + pricing schedule (initial)

Hi Daniel / NovaTech procurement team —

Attaching the first pass of the commercial appendix and the minimum-commit table for the Order Form tied to the Helix Pilot deal (see attached files). Key callouts I want to align on before we hand this to legal for redlines:

- Pricing slabs: Q1 usage band (0-500k tokens) $0.004/token; Q2 (500k-2M) $0.0032/token; over 2M: $0.0026/token.
- Minimum commit: 3-month ramp with an aggregate $150k commit across first quarter (breakdown in min_commit_table_v1.csv).
- Net terms: proposing Net45 standard for mid-market, with an optional early payment 2%/10 discount — need to confirm if NovaTech can accept Net45 or require Net60/Net30.
- Invoicing: monthly in arrears, invoiced to the entity listed on the attached procurement form; taxes: buyer responsible for local VAT/GST; Redwood will gross-up only when legally required (need local tax ID).

Please review the attached: pricing_schedule_v1.xlsx and min_commit_table_v1.csv. If the commercials look broadly acceptable, I’ll loop in Markus (legal) for MSA/order form redlines and push a DocuSign envelope.

Next asks for you:
1) Confirm preferred net terms (Net30/45/60).
2) Confirm invoice remit entity and whether NovaTech requires withholding gross-up.
3) Confirm procurement contact who will sign DocuSign once legal finishes redlines.

Thanks — aim to finalize commercials today/tomorrow if possible so legal can turn in 48 hours.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercials | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: pricing_schedule_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), min_commit_table_v1.csv (csv)
From: Daniel Park <dpark@novatech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novatech.com>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft commercial appendix + pricing schedule (initial)

Kimberly — thanks for the quick send and the clear breakdown. A few notes from procurement after internal review:

- Net terms: our standard is Net60 for new vendor pilots (procurement policy). Can you do Net60? If not, Net45 is acceptable if we get a 30-day payment approval clause in the PO.
- Minimum commit: NovaTech is comfortable with a 3-month ramp but requests a front-loaded trial: 40% of the 3-month commit in month 1, then 30%/30%. Can you put that table in the Order Form appendix?
- Taxes: we will be handling VAT in our region and may need us to provide a tax residency certificate to avoid withholding. Please let us know what VA/TIN you’ll use on invoices.
- Attachments: attaching our procurement_form.pdf with the remit entity and billing address.

Procurement ask: please send an example invoice (sample) showing how Redwood will display taxes and where the remit entity will be listed — that speeds internal PO approvals. Also we’ll need DocuSign once redlines are in.

Thanks — Daniel
Daniel Park
Sr. Procurement Manager | NovaTech
dpark@novatech.com

Attachment: nova_procurement_form.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2029 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft commercial appendix + pricing schedule (initial)

Looping Markus in for legal redlines — quick commercial notes from me before legal digs in:

- Net terms: prefer Net45 from a revenue recognition and cashflow perspective. If NovaTech insists on Net60, propose we keep Net45 in the Order Form and accept a one-time Net60 waiver tied to a PO approval milestone in month 1.
- Early payment discount: suggest 2%/10 be optional and applied on the net invoice if NovaTech signs a letter of intent or gives a PO within 10 days of invoice.
- Minimum commit ramp: Ben supports the proposed front-loaded ramp (40/30/30). Need the table inline in the Order Form to prevent back-and-forth later.

Markus — primary legal asks I want you to confirm:
1) Tax gross-up language and whether Redwood will accept buyer withholding requests with self-supplied tax certificates.
2) Invoice recipient name vs. billing entity — NovaTech's procurement form lists a subsidiary; we need to tie the invoice entity to the legal entity in the MSA to avoid cross-entity risk.
3) Any redline to the indemnity around data residency if they request on-prem logs retention.

Thanks — Ben

---- Forwarded message below ----
> From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
> To: Daniel Park <dpark@novatech.com>
> Date: Thu, 02 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
> Subject: Draft commercial appendix + pricing schedule (initial)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2029 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Draft commercial appendix + pricing schedule (initial) — legal redlines

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the attachments and prepared a redline of the MSA and Order Form (MSA_redline_markus_v2.pdf) — summary of legal asks below (high level):

1) Invoice remit entity: include explicit mapping clause in Order Form (Appendix A) that ties the invoice recipient to the selling Redwood entity. If NovaTech sends a PO to a different entity, we must get a written confirmation that their accounts payable will accept invoices from Redwood Inc.

2) Tax treatment / withholding: add clause that Buyer is responsible for withholding taxes and must provide official tax certificates within 30 days of first invoice. Redwood will gross-up only where statutory withholding applies and will provide documentation to support any gross-up.

3) Net terms and early payment: redline keeps default Net45, with an optional amendment to Net60 only if NovaTech provides a signed waiver on company letterhead tied to the first PO. Early payment 2%/10 is acceptable as an appendix incentive.

4) Minimum commit: require explicit remediation if Buyer fails to meet minimum commits (i.e., invoice for shortfall pro-rated by list price). Suggest a grace period of 14 days to correct PO shortfalls before invoice finalization.

5) Data / logs: if NovaTech requests extended log retention or on-prem sync for compliance, we need an SOW addendum and execute a separate data-handling agreement. Redline flags that in the MSA.

I uploaded the redlined MSA and highlighted the clauses — please review and confirm we should send to NovaTech with a cover note asking procurement to confirm invoice remit entity and net-term preference.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachment: MSA_redline_markus_v2.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@novatech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2029 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Final commercial alignment and next steps (Net45 / ramp / docs)

Daniel — thanks for the quick turnaround and for uploading the procurement form. Per our internal review + Markus’s redlines, here’s what Redwood can commit to and the next steps to get to signature:

Decision summary:
- Net terms: Redwood will keep Net45 on the Order Form. NovaTech may request Net60 as a one-time exception if Procurement provides a signed waiver tied to the first PO.
- Minimum commit ramp: we updated the min_commit_table to front-load 40% month 1, 30% month 2, 30% month 3. Shortfall remediation: invoice for any shortfall after 14-day cure window (per Markus’s redline).
- Pricing slabs: unchanged from the attached schedule.
- Taxes: Buyer responsible for VAT/GST and any local withholding. Please send your tax certificate to ap@redwood.com within 30 days of first invoice to prevent gross-up.

Attachments I've included for your review: OrderForm_revised_20290503.docx (includes the ramp table and Net45 clause). Markus uploaded the redlined MSA for your legal team; his notes are embedded in the Drive link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMSA-redlines

Next steps (action items):
1) Daniel / Procurement: confirm if you will provide the Net60 waiver (if needed) and send the AP tax certificate (sara.lopez@novatech.com is copied).
2) Redwood: Ben will finalize the Order Form and send DocuSign (link will come from docusign@redwood.com).
3) Legal: Markus will stand by for any NovaTech redline replies; otherwise we’ll proceed to DocuSign.

Please confirm by EOB Monday so Ben can issue the DocuSign envelope and we can get this under contract this week.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast alignment.

Best,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercials | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
